info.title: testmaadu.mart demo store API
info.description:
REST API behind the testmaadu.mart demo store (created by TestMaadu.in). Use it to practise API, performance and security testing.

Sign in with POST /auth/login, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Admin: admin@testmaadu.in / Admin@123 (can add, edit and delete products)
- Customer: customer@testmaadu.in / Demo@123

Optional header `X-Demo-Session`: products an admin adds are kept per session id, so each browser sees only its own.

Everything is kept in memory and can reset when the server restarts. Planted bugs are listed in the Demo guide (/demo.html).
